title.en: Anatomy: the four rotator cuff muscles
title.zh: 解剖基础：肩袖的四块肌肉

overview.en: The rotator cuff consists of the supraspinatus, infraspinatus, teres minor, and subscapularis. These muscles connect the scapula to the proximal humerus and help stabilize the humeral head in the glenoid cavity.
overview.zh: 肩袖由冈上肌、冈下肌、小圆肌和肩胛下肌组成。这些肌肉连接肩胛骨与肱骨近端，并帮助将肱骨头稳定在关节盂内。

text.en: O = origin; I = insertion. The dashed O → I line follows the attachment sequence. It is separate from the force arrows used in the movement diagrams.
text.zh: O 表示起点，I 表示止点。虚线 O → I 表示从起点到止点的附着顺序，与动作图中的受力箭头分开。

text.en: Two neighboring muscles that are not part of the rotator cuff
text.zh: 两块不属于肩袖的相邻肌肉

text.en: The [muscle] originates from [origin], passes [direction / relation], and inserts onto [insertion].
text.zh: ［肌肉］起自［起点］，沿［方向／相邻关系］走行，止于［止点］。

text.en: The supraspinatus tendon passes beneath the acromion. Teres minor runs along the inferior border of the infraspinatus.
text.zh: 冈上肌腱从肩峰下方经过。小圆肌沿冈下肌下缘走行。

text.en: It is innervated by [nerve] and contributes to [movement / stability].
text.zh: 它由［神经］支配，并参与［动作／稳定］。

overview.en: Three nerves from the brachial plexus supply the rotator cuff: the suprascapular nerve, the axillary nerve, and the upper and lower subscapular nerves. This chapter follows each nerve along its anatomical course.
overview.zh: 肩袖由臂丛发出的三组神经支配：肩胛上神经、腋神经以及上、下肩胛下神经。本章沿解剖走行逐一追踪这些神经。

paragraphs.en: C stands for cervical (neck), whereas T stands for thoracic (chest). In an innervation label such as C5–C6, the numbers identify the spinal nerve levels contributing fibers to the nerve; they do not identify two thoracic vertebrae. There are seven cervical vertebrae, C1–C7, but eight pairs of cervical spinal nerves, C1–C8. C1–C7 nerves leave above the same-numbered vertebra; C8 leaves between C7 and T1. The roots of the brachial plexus are the anterior rami of spinal nerves C5–T1, not the vertebral bones themselves.
paragraphs.zh: C 是 cervical（颈部）的缩写，T 是 thoracic（胸部）的缩写。神经支配中的 C5–C6 指向该神经贡献纤维的脊神经节段，不是两块胸椎。颈椎有 7 块（C1–C7），颈神经有 8 对（C1–C8）；C1–C7 神经从同名椎骨上方穿出，C8 从 C7 与 T1 之间穿出。臂丛的“根”是 C5–T1 脊神经的前支，而不是椎骨本身。

definitions.zh: 第 1 胸椎 / 第 1 胸神经

rows.en: Superior trunk of the brachial plexus, usually C5–C6
Posterior cord of the brachial plexus, mainly C5–C6
Subscapularis; the lower nerve also supplies Teres major
rows.zh: 肩胛下肌；下肩胛下神经还支配大圆肌

rows.en: Posterior cord of the brachial plexus, usually C5–C6 (some sources include C7)
rows.zh: 臂丛后束，通常为 C5–C6（部分资料含 C7）

text.en: The suprascapular nerve arises from the superior trunk of the brachial plexus, usually carrying fibers from C5 and C6. It courses posterolaterally across the posterior triangle of the neck and passes through the suprascapular notch beneath the superior transverse scapular ligament. It gives motor branches to Supraspinatus in the supraspinous fossa, then passes around the lateral end of the scapular spine through the spinoglenoid notch to supply Infraspinatus in the infraspinous fossa.
text.zh: 肩胛上神经起自臂丛上干，通常含 C5、C6 神经纤维。它向后外侧经过颈后三角，从肩胛上横韧带下方穿过肩胛上切迹，在冈上窝内发出支配冈上肌的运动支；随后绕过肩胛冈外侧端，经冈盂切迹进入冈下窝，支配冈下肌。

text.en: The axillary nerve arises from the posterior cord of the brachial plexus, mainly from C5 and C6. It passes posteriorly through the quadrangular space with the posterior circumflex humeral artery and winds around the surgical neck of the Humerus deep to Deltoid. Its anterior branch supplies the anterior and middle parts of Deltoid. Its posterior branch supplies Teres minor and the posterior part of Deltoid and continues as the superior lateral cutaneous nerve of the arm.
text.zh: 腋神经起自臂丛后束，主要含 C5、C6 神经纤维。它与旋肱后动脉一起向后穿过四边孔，在三角肌深面绕行肱骨外科颈。前支支配三角肌前部和中部；后支支配小圆肌及三角肌后部，并延续为臂外上侧皮神经。

text.en: Brachial plexus: from roots to peripheral nerves

The anterior rami of C5 and C6 unite to form the superior trunk. Each trunk divides into anterior and posterior divisions. The posterior divisions contribute to the posterior cord, from which the axillary and subscapular nerves arise. The suprascapular nerve branches earlier, directly from the superior trunk.
text.zh: C5、C6 脊神经的前支合成上干。各干再分为前股和后股；后股共同组成后束，腋神经和肩胛下神经从后束发出。肩胛上神经更早分出，直接起自上干。

text.en: Roots → Trunks → Divisions → Cords → Branches. “Randy Travis Drinks Cold Beer” is a mnemonic for this sequence.
text.zh: 根 → 干 → 股 → 束 → 支。“Randy Travis Drinks Cold Beer” 用来记忆这个顺序。

title.en: Movement: attachments, force couples, and scapulohumeral rhythm
title.zh: 动作配合：起止点、力偶与肩肱节律

overview.en: Each muscle's line of pull, from origin to insertion, explains its action; the rotator cuff and the scapular muscles then work together in force couples and in scapulohumeral rhythm.
overview.zh: 每块肌肉从起点到止点的拉力线解释了它的动作；肩袖与肩胛肌群再通过力偶和肩肱节律协同工作。

text.en: Supraspinatus runs from the supraspinous fossa to the superior facet of the greater tubercle. Its line of action contributes to shoulder abduction. Infraspinatus and teres minor pass behind the glenohumeral joint to the middle and inferior facets of the greater tubercle, respectively; both contribute to external rotation. Subscapularis passes in front of the joint from the subscapular fossa to the lesser tubercle and contributes to internal rotation.
text.zh: 冈上肌从冈上窝走向大结节上小面，其作用线参与肩关节外展。冈下肌和小圆肌经盂肱关节后方，分别止于大结节中、下小面，两者均参与外旋。肩胛下肌从肩胛下窝经关节前方走向小结节，参与内旋。

text.en: All four muscles also contribute to glenohumeral stability. A muscle’s attachment line helps explain its action, but the resulting movement also depends on joint position and the activity of other muscles.
text.zh: 四块肌肉也都参与盂肱关节稳定。起止点的连线有助于解释肌肉作用，但实际运动还取决于关节位置及其他肌肉的活动。

text.en: At the glenohumeral joint, the deltoid and rotator cuff work together to elevate the arm while controlling the position of the humeral head. At the scapula, the upper and lower trapezius work with serratus anterior to produce upward rotation during arm elevation.
text.zh: 在盂肱关节，三角肌与肩袖协同抬臂，并控制肱骨头的位置。在肩胛骨，上、下斜方肌与前锯肌协作，在上举过程中产生肩胛骨上旋。

text.en: Attachments of the muscles that move the scapula and humerus
text.zh: 带动肩胛骨与肱骨的肌肉起止点

text.en: Arm elevation combines glenohumeral motion with scapulothoracic motion. The familiar 2:1 ratio is a teaching approximation, not a fixed ratio at every angle. Scapular motion varies with the task, the plane of elevation, and the individual.
text.zh: 手臂上举结合了盂肱关节活动和肩胛胸壁活动。常见的 2∶1 是教学概括，并不是每个角度都恒定不变的比例。肩胛骨运动会随任务、上举平面与个体而变化。

paragraphs.en: Supraspinatus and deltoid contribute to initiation of elevation. The rotator cuff helps stabilize the humeral head, while the scapular muscles position the scapula.
paragraphs.zh: 冈上肌与三角肌参与上举起动；肩袖帮助稳定肱骨头，肩胛肌群调节肩胛骨位置。

paragraphs.en: Glenohumeral and scapular motion occur together. Trapezius and serratus anterior contribute to scapular upward rotation, and the clavicle also moves.
paragraphs.zh: 盂肱关节与肩胛骨活动相互配合；斜方肌与前锯肌参与肩胛骨上旋，锁骨也同时运动。

paragraphs.en: Further elevation involves continued scapular upward rotation and posterior tilt, together with humeral external rotation and clavicular motion. These are overlapping contributions rather than isolated on-off stages.
paragraphs.zh: 继续上举涉及肩胛骨持续上旋、后倾，以及肱骨外旋和锁骨运动。这些作用相互重叠，并不是彼此孤立、依次开关的阶段。

summary.zh: 不同上举角度下的肌肉参与

overview.en: This chapter matches each rotator cuff muscle to its special tests, lists common injuries and movement findings, shows the sensory and motor findings of nerve injury, maps shoulder acupoints onto the muscles and nerves beneath them, and ends with a palpation sequence for bony landmarks and the rotator cuff.
overview.zh: 本章把每块肩袖肌肉与对应的特殊检查联系起来，列出常见损伤与动作表现，展示神经损伤的感觉与运动表现，把肩部穴位对应到其下方的肌肉和神经，最后给出骨性标志与肩袖的触诊步骤。

text.en: 4.1 Rotator cuff muscles and special tests

rows.en: Empty can test / Drop arm test
rows.zh: 空罐试验 / 落臂试验

rows.en: Abduction; the subacromial position of the tendon
rows.zh: 外展；肌腱在肩峰下的位置

rows.en: Resisted external rotation / External rotation lag sign
rows.zh: 抗阻外旋 / 外旋滞后征
抬离试验 / 腹压试验

rows.en: Internal rotation; anterior surface of the scapula and lesser tubercle
rows.zh: 内旋；肩胛骨前面与小结节

items.en: The supraspinatus tendon is the structure most often involved in subacromial impingement and tears.
items.zh: 冈上肌腱是肩峰下撞击和撕裂最常累及的结构。

items.en: Entrapment at the suprascapular notch leads to atrophy of both the supraspinatus and the infraspinatus.
items.zh: 肩胛上切迹处卡压会导致冈上肌和冈下肌萎缩。

items.en: Entrapment at the spinoglenoid notch leads to atrophy of the infraspinatus only.
items.zh: 冈盂切迹处卡压只导致冈下肌萎缩。

items.en: Anterior dislocation of the shoulder joint can involve the axillary nerve and the subscapularis.
items.zh: 肩关节前脱位可累及腋神经和肩胛下肌。

items.en: Serratus anterior weakness causes insufficient scapular upward rotation, scapular winging and difficulty elevating the arm.
items.zh: 前锯肌无力会导致肩胛上旋不足、翼状肩胛和上举困难。

items.en: When the upper trapezius is overactive and the lower trapezius is weak, the person compensates by shrugging the shoulder.
items.zh: 上斜方肌过度活跃、下斜方肌无力时，会出现耸肩代偿。

items.en: Rotator cuff weakness involves the deltoid–rotator cuff force couple, upward movement of the humeral head, the subacromial space and pain.
items.zh: 肩袖无力涉及三角肌—肩袖力偶、肱骨头上移、肩峰下间隙与疼痛。

text.en: 4.2 Nerve injury: sensory and motor findings
text.zh: 4.2 神经损伤与感觉、运动表现

text.en: The overlay figure and the acupoint tables in this section are a learning reference. Their layer order and model points are not clinically calibrated and do not indicate needling depth, direction or path. The safety notes in the tables are cautions only.
text.zh: 本节的叠加图和穴位表是学习参照。其中的层次顺序和模型点没有经过临床校准，不表示进针深度、方向或路径。表中的安全提示仅作警示。

summary.en: Acupoints and the muscles beneath them · 9 entries
summary.zh: 穴位与其下方的肌肉 · 9 个条目

text.en: Locations follow [GB/T 12346-2021, Nomenclature and Location of Meridian Points](https://zynj.shutcm.edu.cn/_upload/article/files/66/b4/b34a95604d04b0bf686251b2d317/368ea8b0-187c-48a7-a402-ffdf1e11bb99.pdf). The layers list the muscles encountered from superficial to deep. Dry needling targets trigger points rather than selecting points along the meridians, but the two often lie in the same place.
text.zh: 定位依据：[GB/T 12346-2021《经穴名称与定位》](https://zynj.shutcm.edu.cn/_upload/article/files/66/b4/b34a95604d04b0bf686251b2d317/368ea8b0-187c-48a7-a402-ffdf1e11bb99.pdf)。层次写的是从浅到深会经过的肌肉。干针找的是触发点，不按经络取穴，但两者的位置常常重合。

summary.en: Acupoint correspondences for the neck, the supraclavicular region and the scapular upward rotators
summary.zh: 颈部、锁骨上区与肩胛上旋肌群的穴位对照

summary.en: Bony landmarks and rotator cuff palpation

text.en: From the acromion, palpate medially until you feel a horizontal bony ridge, and follow it all the way to the medial border of the scapula.
text.zh: 从肩峰往内侧摸，摸到一条横的骨嵴，一直摸到肩胛骨内侧缘。

text.en: Press into the fossa above the midpoint of the scapular spine; with the arm at 15° of abduction, have the person abduct against resistance, and you can feel the supraspinatus tighten.
text.zh: 在肩胛冈中点上方的窝里按下去；让他手臂抗阻外展 15°，能摸到冈上肌收紧。

text.en: Palpate the centre of the infraspinous fossa; with the elbow flexed to 90°, have the person externally rotate against resistance, and the whole infraspinatus bulges.
text.zh: 在冈下窝中央触摸；屈肘 90° 做抗阻外旋，整片冈下肌鼓起来。

text.en: Palpate above the upper end of the posterior axillary fold, along the lateral border of the scapula; the teres minor contracts during resisted external rotation, as the infraspinatus does, and lies against the inferior border of the infraspinatus.
text.zh: 在腋后纹头上方、肩胛骨外侧缘触摸；小圆肌与冈下肌一样在抗阻外旋时收缩，紧贴冈下肌下缘。

heading.zh: 肩胛下肌 · 极泉（HT1）方向

text.en: With the person supine and the arm slightly abducted, press from the posterior wall of the axilla toward the anterior surface of the scapula; have the person internally rotate against resistance.
text.zh: 仰卧，手臂稍外展，从腋窝后壁朝肩胛骨前面按；让他抗阻内旋。

overview.en: Short memory cues first, then the same relationships in full sentences, then questions with complete answers.
overview.zh: 先看简短口诀，再读完整句子的同一组关系，最后用问题与完整答案自测。

text.en: Three rotator cuff tendons attach to the greater tubercle, and one attaches to the lesser tubercle.
text.zh: 三条肩袖肌腱附着于大结节，一条附着于小结节。

text.en: Supraspinatus and infraspinatus share the suprascapular nerve; teres minor uses the axillary nerve, and subscapularis uses the subscapular nerves.
text.zh: 冈上肌与冈下肌同由肩胛上神经支配；小圆肌由腋神经支配，肩胛下肌由肩胛下神经支配。

blocks.original: 冈上冈下归肩上，小圆跟腋走，肩下找肩下。

text.en: The superior muscle assists abduction, the posterior muscles assist external rotation, and the anterior muscle assists internal rotation.
text.zh: 上方的肌肉协助外展，后方的肌肉协助外旋，前方的肌肉协助内旋。

text.en: 5.2 The same relationships in full sentences
text.zh: 5.2 完整叙述：位置、支配与动作

text.en: The tendons of supraspinatus, infraspinatus, and teres minor insert on the superior, middle, and inferior facets of the greater tubercle of the humerus, respectively. The subscapularis tendon inserts on the lesser tubercle. These attachments connect the rotator cuff muscles to the proximal humerus.
text.zh: 冈上肌、冈下肌和小圆肌的肌腱分别止于肱骨大结节的上面、中面和下面。肩胛下肌腱止于小结节。这些附着将肩袖肌肉连接到肱骨近端。

text.en: The suprascapular nerve supplies supraspinatus and infraspinatus. The axillary nerve supplies teres minor and also innervates the deltoid. The upper and lower subscapular nerves supply subscapularis, and the lower subscapular nerve also supplies teres major.
text.zh: 肩胛上神经支配冈上肌和冈下肌。腋神经支配小圆肌，也支配三角肌。上、下肩胛下神经支配肩胛下肌，其中下肩胛下神经还支配大圆肌。

text.en: Supraspinatus assists shoulder abduction. Infraspinatus and teres minor assist external rotation, whereas subscapularis assists internal rotation. The rotator cuff muscles also work together to stabilize the humeral head during shoulder movement; their roles extend beyond producing an isolated direction of movement.
text.zh: 冈上肌协助肩外展。冈下肌和小圆肌协助外旋，肩胛下肌协助内旋。肩袖肌肉还共同在肩部运动时稳定肱骨头，因此它们的作用不只是产生某一个单独方向的动作。

text.en: On days 1, 3, 7, and 14, recall each muscle’s origin, insertion, innervation, and action before checking the answer. Connect the name to its location and nearby surface landmarks.
text.zh: 在第 1、3、7、14 天，先回忆每块肌肉的起点、止点、神经支配与动作，再核对答案。把名称与它的位置及附近的体表标志联系起来。

insertion.en: Superior facet of the greater tubercle of the humerus

course.en: The supraspinatus originates from the supraspinous fossa of the scapula, passes laterally beneath the acromion as a tendon, and inserts onto the superior facet of the greater tubercle of the humerus.
course.zh: 冈上肌起自肩胛骨冈上窝，以肌腱向外侧经肩峰下方走行，止于肱骨大结节上小面。

actions.en: It contributes to shoulder abduction and helps stabilize the humeral head in the glenoid cavity.
actions.zh: 它参与肩关节外展，并帮助将肱骨头稳定在关节盂内。

innervation.zh: 肩胛上神经（通常为 C5–C6）

insertion.en: Middle facet of the greater tubercle of the humerus

course.en: The infraspinatus originates from the infraspinous fossa of the scapula, passes laterally behind the glenohumeral joint as its fibers converge into a tendon, and inserts onto the middle facet of the greater tubercle of the humerus.
course.zh: 冈下肌起自肩胛骨冈下窝，肌纤维汇聚成肌腱，向外侧经盂肱关节后方走行，止于肱骨大结节中小面。

actions.en: It externally rotates the humerus and contributes to dynamic stability of the glenohumeral joint.
actions.zh: 它使肱骨外旋，并参与盂肱关节的动态稳定。

innervation.zh: 肩胛上神经（通常为 C5–C6）

origin.en: Upper part of the lateral border of the scapula

insertion.en: Inferior facet of the greater tubercle of the humerus

course.en: The teres minor originates from the upper part of the lateral border of the scapula, passes superolaterally along the inferior border of the infraspinatus, and inserts onto the inferior facet of the greater tubercle of the humerus.
course.zh: 小圆肌起自肩胛骨外侧缘上部，沿冈下肌下缘向上外侧走行，止于肱骨大结节下小面。

actions.en: It assists external rotation of the humerus and helps stabilize the humeral head. Teres major is a separate muscle and is not part of the rotator cuff.
actions.zh: 它协助肱骨外旋并帮助稳定肱骨头。大圆肌是另一块肌肉，不属于肩袖。

origin.en: Subscapular fossa on the anterior surface of the scapula
origin.zh: 肩胛骨前面的肩胛下窝

course.en: The subscapularis originates from the subscapular fossa on the anterior surface of the scapula, passes laterally in front of the glenohumeral joint, and inserts onto the lesser tubercle of the humerus.
course.zh: 肩胛下肌起自肩胛骨前面的肩胛下窝，经盂肱关节前方向外侧走行，止于肱骨小结节。

actions.en: It internally rotates the humerus and contributes to anterior stability of the glenohumeral joint.
actions.zh: 它使肱骨内旋，并参与盂肱关节前方的稳定。

innervation.en: Upper and lower subscapular nerves (C5–C6; some sources include C7)
innervation.zh: 上、下肩胛下神经（C5–C6；部分资料还包括 C7）

origin.en: Posterior surface of the inferior angle of the scapula

insertion.en: Medial lip of the intertubercular groove (crest of the lesser tubercle) of the humerus
insertion.zh: 肱骨结节间沟内侧唇（小结节嵴）

course.en: The teres major originates from the posterior surface of the inferior angle of the scapula, passes superolaterally below the teres minor and anterior to the long head of the triceps brachii, and inserts onto the medial lip of the intertubercular groove of the humerus.
course.zh: 大圆肌起自肩胛骨下角后面，在小圆肌下方、肱三头肌长头前方向上外侧走行，止于肱骨结节间沟内侧唇。

actions.en: It adducts and medially rotates the arm at the glenohumeral joint and helps extend the arm from a flexed position. Teres major is not part of the rotator cuff; it forms the inferior border of the quadrangular space.
actions.zh: 它在盂肱关节使上臂内收和内旋，并协助上臂从屈曲位伸展。大圆肌不属于肩袖；它构成四边孔的下界。

innervation.en: Lower subscapular nerve, from the posterior cord of the brachial plexus (usually C5–C6; some sources include C7)
innervation.zh: 下肩胛下神经，发自臂丛后束（通常为 C5–C6，部分资料含 C7）

origin.en: External occipital protuberance and medial third of the superior nuchal line of the occipital bone, the nuchal ligament, and the spinous processes of the C7–T12 vertebrae
origin.zh: 枕骨的枕外隆凸和上项线内侧三分之一、项韧带，以及 C7–T12 椎骨棘突

insertion.en: Posterior border of the lateral third of the clavicle, the medial margin of the acromion, and the superior lip of the spine of the scapula as far as the tubercle at its medial end
insertion.zh: 锁骨外侧三分之一后缘、肩峰内侧缘，以及肩胛冈上唇直至其内侧端的结节

course.en: The trapezius originates from the occipital bone, the nuchal ligament and the spinous processes of the C7–T12 vertebrae, passes laterally as its fibers converge on the shoulder, and inserts onto the lateral third of the clavicle, the acromion and the spine of the scapula. The upper trapezius (descending part) runs inferolaterally to the clavicle, the middle trapezius (transverse part) runs horizontally to the acromion and the lateral part of the scapular spine, and the lower trapezius (ascending part) runs superolaterally to the medial end of the scapular spine. The vertebral levels at which the parts divide differ between sources.
course.zh: 斜方肌起自枕骨、项韧带和 C7–T12 椎骨棘突，肌纤维向肩部汇聚并向外侧走行，止于锁骨外侧三分之一、肩峰和肩胛冈。上斜方肌（降部）向下外侧走向锁骨，中斜方肌（横部）水平走向肩峰和肩胛冈外侧部，下斜方肌（升部）向上外侧走向肩胛冈内侧端。各部分界的椎骨节段在不同资料中略有出入。

actions.en: The upper part elevates the scapula, the middle part retracts it, and the lower part depresses its medial part. The upper and lower parts work with serratus anterior to rotate the scapula upward during arm elevation. With the scapula fixed, the upper part extends and laterally flexes the neck.
actions.zh: 上部上提肩胛骨，中部使肩胛骨后缩，下部使肩胛骨内侧部下降。上部和下部与前锯肌协作，在手臂上举时使肩胛骨上旋。肩胛骨固定时，上部可使颈部后伸并侧屈。

innervation.en: Spinal accessory nerve (cranial nerve XI) for motor supply; anterior rami of the C3 and C4 spinal nerves through the cervical plexus, usually described as proprioceptive (sensory), although a cadaveric study found motor axons in these branches
innervation.zh: 副神经（第十一对脑神经）提供运动支配；C3、C4 脊神经前支经颈丛加入，通常被描述为本体感觉（感觉）纤维，但一项尸体研究在这些分支中发现了运动轴突

origin.en: Lateral third of the clavicle, the acromion, and the spine of the scapula
origin.zh: 锁骨外侧三分之一、肩峰和肩胛冈

course.en: The deltoid originates from the lateral third of the clavicle, the acromion, and the spine of the scapula, passes toward the humerus as its fibers converge, and inserts onto the deltoid tuberosity of the humerus.
course.zh: 三角肌起自锁骨外侧三分之一、肩峰和肩胛冈，肌纤维向肱骨汇聚走行，止于肱骨三角肌粗隆。

actions.en: The middle, or acromial, part contributes strongly to arm abduction.
actions.zh: 其中部，即肩峰部，是手臂外展的重要参与者。

course.en: The upper trapezius originates from the occipital region and the nuchal ligament, passes inferolaterally, and inserts onto the lateral third of the clavicle.
course.zh: 上斜方肌起自枕部和项韧带，向下外侧走行，止于锁骨外侧三分之一。

actions.en: The upper fibers of trapezius act with the other scapular rotators during elevation of the arm.
actions.zh: 斜方肌上部纤维在手臂上举时与其他肩胛旋转肌协作。

innervation.en: Accessory nerve (cranial nerve XI); anterior rami of C3–C4, usually described as proprioceptive (sensory)
innervation.zh: 副神经（第十一对脑神经）；C3–C4 脊神经前支，通常被描述为本体感觉（感觉）纤维

origin.en: Spinous processes of the lower thoracic vertebrae, commonly described as T4–T12
origin.zh: 下部胸椎棘突，常描述为 T4–T12

insertion.en: Scapular spine, near its medial end

course.en: The lower trapezius originates from the spinous processes of the lower thoracic vertebrae, commonly described as T4–T12, passes superolaterally, and inserts onto the scapular spine near its medial end. Here T denotes thoracic vertebrae.
course.zh: 下斜方肌起自下部胸椎棘突（常描述为 T4–T12），向上外侧走行，止于肩胛冈内侧端附近。这里的 T 表示胸椎。

actions.en: The lower fibers of trapezius work with the upper trapezius and serratus anterior to produce upward rotation of the scapula during arm elevation.
actions.zh: 斜方肌下部纤维与上斜方肌和前锯肌协作，在手臂上举时产生肩胛骨上旋。

innervation.en: Accessory nerve (cranial nerve XI); anterior rami of C3–C4, usually described as proprioceptive (sensory)
innervation.zh: 副神经（第十一对脑神经）；C3–C4 脊神经前支，通常被描述为本体感觉（感觉）纤维

origin.en: Lateral surfaces of the upper eight or nine ribs
origin.zh: 上八或九根肋骨的外侧面

insertion.en: Anterior, or costal, surface of the medial border of the scapula
insertion.zh: 肩胛骨内侧缘的前面（肋面）

course.en: The serratus anterior originates from the lateral surfaces of the upper eight or nine ribs, passes around the thoracic wall, and inserts onto the anterior, or costal, surface of the medial border of the scapula.
course.zh: 前锯肌起自上八或九根肋骨的外侧面，绕过胸壁，止于肩胛骨内侧缘的前面（肋面）。

actions.en: Its inferior fibers attach near the inferior angle and contribute to upward rotation.
actions.zh: 其下部纤维附着于下角附近，参与肩胛骨上旋。

description.en: The greater tubercle is the bony prominence on the lateral side of the proximal humerus, separated from the lesser tubercle by the intertubercular groove. The supraspinatus, infraspinatus and teres minor insert onto its superior, middle and inferior facets, respectively.
description.zh: 大结节是肱骨近端外侧的骨性隆起，与小结节之间隔着结节间沟。冈上肌、冈下肌和小圆肌分别止于它的上小面、中小面和下小面。

description.en: The lesser tubercle is the smaller prominence on the anterior surface of the proximal humerus, medial to the greater tubercle across the intertubercular groove. The subscapularis inserts onto it.
description.zh: 小结节是肱骨近端前面较小的骨性隆起，隔着结节间沟位于大结节内侧。肩胛下肌止于小结节。

description.en: The supraspinous fossa is the smaller area on the posterior surface of the scapula, above the scapular spine. The supraspinatus originates here, and the suprascapular nerve crosses the fossa and gives motor branches to that muscle.
description.zh: 冈上窝是肩胛骨后面、肩胛冈上方较小的区域。冈上肌起于此处，肩胛上神经横过冈上窝，并向冈上肌发出运动支。

description.en: The infraspinous fossa is the larger area on the posterior surface of the scapula, below the scapular spine. The infraspinatus originates here, and the suprascapular nerve enters the fossa through the spinoglenoid notch to supply that muscle.
description.zh: 冈下窝是肩胛骨后面、肩胛冈下方较大的区域。冈下肌起于此处，肩胛上神经经冈盂切迹进入冈下窝，支配冈下肌。

description.en: The subscapular fossa is the large concave depression that covers most of the costal (anterior) surface of the scapula, which faces the rib cage. The subscapularis originates from it.
description.zh: 肩胛下窝是肩胛骨肋面（前面）上的大片凹陷，占据该面的大部分；肋面朝向胸廓。肩胛下肌起于肩胛下窝。

modelUnavailableReason.en: The 3D model has no separate marker for this landmark; select the scapula to see the bone.
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 三维模型没有单独标记这一结构；请选择肩胛骨查看所在骨骼。

description.en: The acromion is the lateral extension of the scapular spine that arches over the glenohumeral joint and articulates with the clavicle. The supraspinatus tendon passes beneath it, and part of the deltoid originates from it.
description.zh: 肩峰是肩胛冈向外侧的延伸，呈弓形覆盖在盂肱关节上方，并与锁骨相关节。冈上肌腱从肩峰下方经过，三角肌也有一部分起于肩峰。

description.en: The glenoid cavity is the shallow socket at the upper end of the lateral border of the scapula, inferior to the coracoid process, where the head of the humerus articulates to form the glenohumeral joint. The rotator cuff muscles help stabilize the humeral head in this socket.
description.zh: 关节盂是肩胛骨外侧缘上端、喙突下方的浅窝，与肱骨头相关节，构成盂肱关节。肩袖肌群帮助将肱骨头稳定在关节盂内。

modelUnavailableReason.en: The 3D model has no separate marker for this landmark; select the scapula to see the bone.
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 三维模型没有单独标记这一结构；请选择肩胛骨查看所在骨骼。

description.en: The suprascapular notch lies just medial to the coracoid process, where the superior border of the scapula meets the base of the coracoid process. The suprascapular nerve passes through it beneath the superior transverse scapular ligament before supplying the supraspinatus and infraspinatus, so compression here can affect both muscles.
description.zh: 肩胛上切迹位于喙突内侧，即肩胛骨上缘与喙突基底部相接处。肩胛上神经从肩胛上横韧带下方穿过此切迹，随后支配冈上肌和冈下肌，因此在此处受压可同时累及这两块肌肉。

modelUnavailableReason.en: The 3D model has no separate marker for this landmark; select the scapula to see the bone.
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 三维模型没有单独标记这一结构；请选择肩胛骨查看所在骨骼。

description.en: The spinoglenoid notch lies on the back of the scapula, behind the scapular neck and beneath the acromion, and connects the supraspinous and infraspinous fossae. The suprascapular nerve curves around the lateral border of the scapular spine through this notch into the infraspinous fossa to supply the infraspinatus, so compression here can cause isolated atrophy of the infraspinatus while the supraspinatus is spared.
description.zh: 冈盂切迹位于肩胛骨后面，在肩胛颈后方、肩峰下方，连通冈上窝和冈下窝。肩胛上神经绕过肩胛冈外侧缘，经此切迹进入冈下窝，支配冈下肌；因此在此处受压可只引起冈下肌萎缩，而冈上肌不受累。

modelUnavailableReason.en: The 3D model has no separate marker for this landmark; select the scapula to see the bone.
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 三维模型没有单独标记这一结构；请选择肩胛骨查看所在骨骼。

description.en: The quadrangular space is a gap in the posterior axilla, bounded by the teres minor superiorly, the teres major inferiorly, the long head of the triceps brachii medially and the surgical neck of the humerus laterally. The axillary nerve passes through it with the posterior circumflex humeral artery before supplying the teres minor and the deltoid.
description.zh: 四边孔是腋区后部的间隙，上界为小圆肌，下界为大圆肌，内界为肱三头肌长头，外界为肱骨外科颈。腋神经与旋肱后动脉一起穿过四边孔，随后支配小圆肌和三角肌。

modelUnavailableReason.en: The 3D model has no separate marker for this space; select teres minor, teres major, the long head of triceps or the humerus to see its four borders.
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 三维模型没有单独标记四边孔；可分别选择小圆肌、大圆肌、肱三头肌长头或肱骨，查看它的四条边界。

location.en: In the depression at the junction of the upper one third and the lower two thirds of the line connecting the midpoint of the scapular spine with the inferior angle of the scapula.
location.zh: 肩胛冈中点与肩胛下角连线上 1/3 与下 2/3 交点凹陷中。

target.en: Infraspinatus trigger point, referring deep into the anterior shoulder
target.zh: 冈下肌触发点，牵涉到肩前深部

howToFind.en: Palpate the centre of the infraspinous fossa; with the elbow flexed to 90°, have the person externally rotate against resistance, and the whole infraspinatus bulges.
howToFind.zh: 在冈下窝中央触摸；屈肘 90° 做抗阻外旋，整片冈下肌鼓起来。

safety.en: Bone lies deep to the point, so it is relatively safe.

location.en: Superior to the midpoint of the scapular spine, in the supraspinous fossa.
location.zh: 肩胛冈中点上方，冈上窝中。

target.en: Supraspinatus trigger point, referring to the lateral deltoid
target.zh: 冈上肌触发点，牵涉到三角肌外侧

howToFind.en: Press into the fossa above the midpoint of the scapular spine; with the arm at 15° of abduction, have the person abduct against resistance, and you can feel the supraspinatus tighten.
howToFind.zh: 在肩胛冈中点上方的窝里按下去；让他手臂抗阻外展 15°，能摸到冈上肌收紧。

safety.en: The suprascapular nerve and blood vessels lie deep to the point.
safety.zh: 深面有肩胛上神经和血管。

location.en: In the depression at the superior border of the medial end of the scapular spine.
location.zh: 肩胛冈内侧端上缘凹陷中。

layers.zh: 斜方肌 → 冈上肌（内侧）

howToFind.en: SI13 is located at the midpoint of the line connecting Naoshu (SI10) with the spinous process of the second thoracic vertebra (T2).
howToFind.zh: 臑俞（SI10）与第2胸椎棘突连线的中点处。

safety.en: Do not needle deeply in an inferomedial direction.

location.en: In the depression between the acromial end of the clavicle and the scapular spine.
location.zh: 锁骨肩峰端与肩胛冈之间凹陷中。

howToFind.en: The point lies in the depression between the two bones at the lateral end of the supraspinous fossa.
howToFind.zh: 冈上窝外端两骨间凹陷中。

safety.en: Use oblique insertion and do not needle deeply.

location.en: Directly above the upper end of the posterior axillary fold, in the depression at the inferior border of the scapular spine.
location.zh: 腋后纹头直上，肩胛冈下缘凹陷中。

layers.zh: 三角肌后部 → 冈下肌

target.en: Lateral part of the infraspinatus; posterior deltoid
target.zh: 冈下肌外侧、三角肌后束

safety.en: No specific safety caution is recorded for this point.
safety.zh: 该穴位未记录特定安全提示。

location.en: Posteroinferior to the shoulder joint, 1 B-cun directly above the upper end of the posterior axillary fold.
location.zh: 肩关节后下方，腋后纹头直上 1 寸。

layers.en: Posterior border of the deltoid → teres minor and teres major
layers.zh: 三角肌后缘 → 小圆肌、大圆肌

howToFind.en: Palpate above the upper end of the posterior axillary fold, along the lateral border of the scapula; the teres minor contracts during resisted external rotation, as the infraspinatus does, and lies against the inferior border of the infraspinatus.
howToFind.zh: 在腋后纹头上方、肩胛骨外侧缘触摸；小圆肌与冈下肌一样在抗阻外旋时收缩，紧贴冈下肌下缘。

safety.en: The quadrangular space lies deep to the point, with the axillary nerve and the posterior circumflex humeral artery.
safety.zh: 深面为四边孔，有腋神经和旋肱后动脉。

location.en: On the shoulder girdle, in the depression between the acromial angle and the greater tubercle of the humerus.
location.zh: 在肩带部，肩峰角与肱骨大结节两骨间凹陷中。

layers.en: Deltoid → near the infraspinatus and the teres minor tendon
layers.zh: 三角肌 → 冈下肌、小圆肌腱附近

howToFind.en: With the arm flexed and abducted, two depressions appear at the anterior and posterior ends of the lateral border of the acromion; the deeper anterior depression is Jianyu (LI15) and the posterior depression is this point. With the arm hanging at the side, the point is about 1 B-cun posterior to Jianyu (LI15).
howToFind.zh: 屈臂外展时，肩峰外侧缘前后端呈现两个凹陷，前一较深凹陷为肩髃（LI15），后一凹陷即本穴。垂肩时，肩髃（LI15）后约1寸。

safety.en: No specific safety caution is recorded for this point.
safety.zh: 该穴位未记录特定安全提示。

location.en: In the depression between the anterior end of the lateral border of the acromion and the greater tubercle of the humerus.
location.zh: 肩峰外侧缘前端与肱骨大结节两骨间凹陷中。

layers.en: Deltoid → supraspinatus tendon and subacromial bursa
layers.zh: 三角肌 → 冈上肌腱、肩峰下滑囊

target.en: Anterior and middle deltoid; the point closest to the site of subacromial pain
target.zh: 三角肌前、中束；最贴近肩峰下疼痛部位

howToFind.en: With the arm flexed and abducted, two depressions appear at the anterior and posterior ends of the lateral border of the acromion; the deeper anterior depression is this point, and the posterior depression is Jianliao (TE14).
howToFind.zh: 屈臂外展，肩峰外侧缘前后端呈现两个凹陷，前一较深凹陷即本穴，后一凹陷为肩髎（TE14）。

safety.en: No specific safety caution is recorded for this point.
safety.zh: 该穴位未记录特定安全提示。

location.en: At the centre of the axilla, where the pulse of the axillary artery can be felt.
location.zh: 腋窝中央，腋动脉搏动处。

layers.en: Axillary fat → deep, near the subscapularis
layers.zh: 腋窝脂肪 → 深面近肩胛下肌

howToFind.en: To palpate the subscapularis through the Jiquan (axillary) approach: with the person supine and the arm slightly abducted, press from the posterior wall of the axilla toward the anterior surface of the scapula, and have the person internally rotate against resistance.
howToFind.zh: 经极泉（腋窝）入路触诊肩胛下肌：仰卧，手臂稍外展，从腋窝后壁朝肩胛骨前面按；让他抗阻内旋。

safety.en: The axillary artery and the brachial plexus lie here; this point requires specialised training.
safety.zh: 此处有腋动脉和臂丛；需专门训练。

location.en: On both sides of the spinous processes of the C5 and C6 vertebrae, 0.5 B-cun lateral to the posterior median line.
location.zh: C5、C6 椎骨棘突两侧，后正中线旁开 0.5 寸。

safety.en: The tissue deep to the point lies close to where the C5 and C6 nerve roots exit.
safety.zh: 深面靠近 C5、C6 神经根出口。

location.en: In the anterior region of the neck, in the greater supraclavicular fossa, 4 B-cun lateral to the anterior median line, in the depression superior to the clavicle.
location.zh: 在颈前部，锁骨上大窝，锁骨上缘凹陷中，前正中线旁开4寸。

safety.en: The superior and middle trunks of the brachial plexus, the subclavian artery and the apex of the lung lie deep to the point; deep needling is prohibited.
safety.zh: 深面有臂丛上干和中干、锁骨下动脉、肺尖；禁深刺。

location.en: In the posterior region of the neck, at the midpoint of the line connecting the spinous process of the seventh cervical vertebra (C7) with the most lateral point of the acromion.
location.zh: 在颈后部，第7颈椎棘突与肩峰最外侧点连线的中点。

safety.en: The apex of the lung lies deep to the point; deep needling is prohibited.

location.en: In the lateral thoracic region, in the fourth intercostal space, 1 B-cun anterior to the midaxillary line.
location.zh: 在侧胸部，第4肋间隙中，腋中线前1寸。

safety.en: The pleura lies deep to the point; use horizontal (transverse) insertion.

caption.zh: 后面观。冈下肌起自肩胛骨冈下窝（O），止于肱骨大结节中小面（I）。附着区域为示意，虚线箭头表示起点到止点的附着关系，并非力矢量。

Attachment areas are schematic, and the dashed arrow maps origin to insertion rather than showing a force vector.
caption.zh: 后面观。小圆肌起自肩胛骨外侧缘上部（O），止于肱骨大结节下小面（I）。附着区域为示意，虚线箭头表示起点到止点的附着关系，并非力矢量。

question.en: Which three rotator cuff muscles insert on the greater tubercle, and which muscle inserts on the lesser tubercle?
question.zh: 哪三块肩袖肌止于大结节，哪一块止于小结节？

answer.en: Supraspinatus, infraspinatus, and teres minor insert on the superior, middle, and inferior facets of the greater tubercle, respectively. Subscapularis inserts on the lesser tubercle. The order on the greater tubercle is therefore supraspinatus, infraspinatus, and teres minor from superior to inferior.
answer.zh: 冈上肌、冈下肌和小圆肌分别止于大结节的上面、中面和下面。肩胛下肌止于小结节。因此，大结节上从上到下的顺序是冈上肌、冈下肌、小圆肌。

question.en: How does the innervation of infraspinatus differ from that of teres minor, even though both assist external rotation?
question.zh: 冈下肌与小圆肌都协助外旋，但二者的神经支配有什么不同？

answer.en: Infraspinatus is innervated by the suprascapular nerve, whereas teres minor is innervated by the axillary nerve. A shared action does not imply a shared peripheral nerve supply.
answer.zh: 冈下肌由肩胛上神经支配，而小圆肌由腋神经支配。具有相同动作，并不意味着由同一条周围神经支配。

question.en: Why can suprascapular nerve compression at the suprascapular notch affect different muscles from compression at the spinoglenoid notch?
question.zh: 为什么肩胛上神经在肩胛上切迹与冈盂切迹受压时，可能累及不同的肌肉？

answer.en: The suprascapular nerve passes through the suprascapular notch before supplying supraspinatus and then continues toward infraspinatus through the spinoglenoid notch. Compression at the suprascapular notch can therefore affect both muscles. Compression at the spinoglenoid notch occurs farther along the nerve and may affect infraspinatus while sparing supraspinatus.
answer.zh: 肩胛上神经先经过肩胛上切迹，再发出支配冈上肌的分支，随后经冈盂切迹继续走向冈下肌。因此，在肩胛上切迹受压可能累及这两块肌肉；在更远端的冈盂切迹受压，则可能累及冈下肌而保留冈上肌的功能。

question.en: During arm elevation, how do the rotator cuff muscles and the muscles that move the scapula contribute to shoulder function?
question.zh: 上举手臂时，肩袖肌群与带动肩胛骨的肌群分别怎样参与肩部功能？

answer.en: The rotator cuff muscles help stabilize and rotate the humeral head at the glenohumeral joint. Serratus anterior and the upper and lower portions of trapezius coordinate scapular upward rotation as the arm elevates. Humeral motion and scapular motion therefore work together during elevation.
answer.zh: 肩袖肌群帮助在盂肱关节处稳定并转动肱骨头。随着手臂上举，前锯肌与斜方肌的上部、下部协调肩胛骨上旋。因此，上举过程需要肱骨运动与肩胛骨运动相互配合。
